{{Quote|Death to the Imperial Remnant. Death to the New Republic. Long live the Restored Empire. Long live Palpatine!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Restored Empire''', also known as the '''Kaarenth Dissension''', was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] created by [[Ennix Devian]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] that became prominent after the [[Imperial Reunification]], refusing the authority of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The members of the Restored Empire were informally known as the '''hard-liners'''.

==Description==
[[File:Devian.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Ennix Devian]].]]
The Restored Empire symbol was a modified [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]] with an additional inner circle.

It was led by [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Ennix Devian]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] and former [[Imperial Assassin]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]], [[Bulger]], [[Durrei]], [[Klemp]], and [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] [[Lonkin]] were all members.

The Restored Empire base was a secret [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era military base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[RZ7-6113-23]].

==History==
When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Death/Legends|died]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fractured into myriad factions, Ennix Devian, a personal hitman of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], concluded that in order for the Empire to restore itself it needed a group that truly believed in the ideals of the [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]], so Devian founded the Kaarenth Dissension. The Kaarenth Dissension was dedicated to "the sacred Restoration of the True Empire of Palpatine." His first move was to seize control of two incomplete [[Worldcraft]] but, too expensive to finish, Devian rerouted them to opposite ends of the galaxy: one to the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] and the other to [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]]. The Worldcraft on Moddell, which had been deliberately modified by Devian to be [[Death Star III|modeled]] after the infamous [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] as part of a feint against the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] (the successor group of the Rebel Alliance), was [[Battle of Death Star III|destroyed]] by Rebel agents and [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours's]] passengers.

The Kaarenth Dissension resurfaced following the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]] and [[Operation Shadow Hand]] under the public control of the silver-tongued [[Meres Ulcane]]. The Dissension now was dedicated to inciting the various alien races of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A fleet of warships and accompanying repair station was constructed in the Spawn Nebula. Meres Ulcane proved to be a motivational speaker and managed to stir up a great deal of animosity towards the New Republic. The Dissension successfully launched a [[Assault on Galaan|strike]] against a New Republic communications center on the gas giant [[Galaan/Legends|Galaan]].

[[File:Kaarenth_Dissension.svg|thumb|right|150px|The early logo of the Kaarenth Dissension prior to reformation as the Restored Empire]]
However, Meres Ulcane was eventually discovered on [[Betha II]], and fled back to the Spawn Nebula. The New Republic tracked him and engaged the Kaarenth Dissension in a [[Mission to the Spawn Nebula|operation]] that wiped out much of its fleet. Ulcane himself was killed in the destruction of the repair station, in truth the second worldcraft.

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], calling his group Restored Empire, Supreme Commander Devian organized a complex plot to destroy the New Republic and take control of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

The first phase of his operation was an attempt to [[Phase One|assassinate]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her children on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The attack failed due to the intervention of [[Mirith Sinn]], but it was without consequence for the following operations.

Another part of Devian's plot included the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Nom Anor]] and the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]]. While Devian hired Fett to bring Kir Kanos to the Restored Empire headquarters, Nom Anor hired a team of thieves to [[Raid on Nyara|attack]] the [[class-3 toxic weapons dump]] on [[Nyara]] in order to retrieve a chunk of [[zinethium]]. Devian wanted to use this destructive material to destroy the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on Coruscant and eliminate the Republic government. As expected, Kir Kanos refused to join the hard-liners who imprisoned him. Devian later let him escape and sacrificed some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to convince Kanos he was really free. Kir Kanos immediately departed to Coruscant to warn the Republic, but he was unaware that Devian had embedded the zinethium inside the shuttle, predicting Kanos would travel to the galactic capital. This time, it was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] who prevented the attack.

[[File:Orinda.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Devian's fleet attacks Orinda.]]
Devian later learned that Republic and Imperial [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], including Kanos, Mirith Sinn and [[Feena D'Asta]], had planned to meet to discuss a truce between the two factions. The Restored Empire stormtroopers who [[Ambush at the peace negotiations|attacked]] the meeting were all eliminated, but D'Asta was killed.

Shocked by the death of Feena D'Asta and suspecting a Republic betrayal, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] ordered the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to attack the Republic in retaliation, leaving the Imperial capital [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] insufficiently defended. The ancient but massive Restored Empire fleet was able to destroy the small defense fleet and [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|attack]] the planet.

==Military forces==
{{Quote|Numerous weapons and ships scheduled for decommission of destruction were rerouted here over the years, repaired and maintained. [sic] I have an armada of ''Venator''-class Star destroyers, and even more Acclamator-class assault ships ready to be loaded with troops.|[[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] Devian to [[Kir Kanos]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Restored_Empire_tattoo.png|thumb|right|250px|Soldiers in the Restored Empire had the insignia tattooed on their bodies.]]
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Kaarenth Dissension gathered starships in the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]] in order to create a secret armada. These vessels included [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]], [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol crafts]], [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and one [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref>

Although using [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the rest of its military hardware appeared to consist entirely of vehicles and vessels used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], including:

*[[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]
*[[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]]
*[[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]]
*[[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]]
*[[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pods]]
*[[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]]
*[[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]]
*[[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/carriers]]
*[[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttles]]

Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], numerous weapons and ships scheduled for decommission or scrapping were rerouted to the Restored Empire's base, constituting with the years a massive military force.

Other ships included [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s and [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]].
